subject: High School Site Selection Options
overview: The MPS High School Building Committee reviewed the timeline and evaluation criteria for the upcoming designer selection process and received an update on the high school educational plan. The committee also voted to eliminate specific properties from the list of prospective sites for the feasibility study.

items.title: Designer Selection Process and Evaluation
items.summary: The committee reviewed the MSBA designer selection timeline, qualifications-based criteria, and evaluation matrices ahead of the August 27 application deadline.

items.title: Educational Plan Progress Report
items.summary: Dr. Suzanne Galusi provided an update on the high school educational plan, detailing draft timelines and teacher study tours of recently built high schools in Dover, Waltham, and Attleboro.

items.title: Site Selection Options Review
items.summary: Approved a motion to remove Medford Square and Columbus Park from the list of potential high school site options for the feasibility study.
